historical_premise.status_at_date: tentative reported anomaly inviting independent scrutiny, not confirmed faster-than-light travel
historical_premise.text_trigger: 20 parts per million above the speed of light

conditional_speed_hypothesis.assumption: Same constant speed excess carries across the later beams and each laboratory

inference: 2012 measurements near zero instead of about 49 nanoseconds challenge this specific constant-speed-excess explanation, conditional on each instrument calibration, beam comparability and error assumptions; original 2011 excess should remain a dated observation/anomaly rather than universal truth
confounders: 20ppm and 730km are rounded historical figures: this does not reproduce exact 2011 estimated 60ns early arrival
Systematic components within and between experiments are not demonstrated independent or exactly Gaussian
New 2012 measurements used upgraded apparatus and beam protocols
Energy/particle/measurement settings may constrain physical extrapolation: neutrino versus antineutrino must not be conflated
Post-hoc additional-error sensitivity is a stress test, not estimated real error
As-of-2011 availability cannot include March, June, August or December 2012 evidence
scope_controls: Dream/fiction or quotation of superluminal claim is not a positive propagation observation
2012 OPERA and ICARUS are distinct authors/experiments; no automatic name merging
February 2012 possible timing faults are not yet independently confirmed diagnoses as of that date
